description: This file defines a final class 'TestConnectionConflictStrategy' which extends an abstract class for handling 'TestConnection' commands in a conflict scenario within a connection management system. It implements logic to generate a result indicating that the connection already exists, responding appropriately to a conflict during a test connection command execution.

classes.name: TestConnectionConflictStrategy
classes.description: A final class that handles 'TestConnection' commands during conflict scenarios by returning a result indicating the connection is already established.

methods.name: TestConnectionConflictStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the strategy by specifying it handles 'TestConnection' commands.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Overrides the abstract method to produce a result indicating the connection has already been created when a conflict occurs during a 'TestConnection' command.
